source.text: General Atomic report GA-7882, Kinetic Behavior of TRIGA Reactors (1967), Table VII, page 31, modified Fuchs-Nordheim model (C = C0 + C1 T), $5 pulse (delta k prompt 0.028): peak power 9210 MW, burst energy 59.7 MW s, temperature rise of the burst 506 C (parameters: lifetime 4e-5 s, C0 = 8e4 W s/C at 25 C, C1 = 1.5e2 W s/C^2, alpha = 1e-4 per C per core). The energy of the slice is the burst energy of the core over the 720 pins of 1 m.
source.check: Cross-check: tests/gaKineticsTable.test.ts derives the same model exactly (Simpson's rule) and gets 9212.0 MW, 59.65 MW s and a rise of 505.8 C; FEED's generator agrees with that to 1e-4. The report's numbers are rounded and its equation 16 for the rise is an approximation, so the tolerance is 0.5 %.

coverage.domain: TRIGA-like core of the report GA-7882 (Table VII): $5 pulse, prompt neutrons only (no delayed groups), constant prompt coefficient of -1e-4 per K, heat capacity C = C0 + C1 T, 60 ms window (the pulse is over in about 45 ms), initial power 100 kW (about 5e-5 of the peak: the report neglects it); the core is 720 pins of 1 m, the pin an illustrative synthetic one
